verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins is a plugin platform rather than an agent itself, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. The MCP evidence is all host-side, though: plugins bundle or wire MCP servers so ChatGPT and Codex can consume tools. Nothing shows a first-party MCP server that an external agent can connect to in order to drive Codex Plugins itself, and developer building blocks and client-side MCP support earn no credit here.
